shellCommands.command: cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && echo ---- && find .agents/skills/gravity-ui -type f && echo ---- && ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null | head -80

cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -120 && echo ---- && rg -n -i "calendar|date" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && echo ---- && find src -type f | xargs ls -la && echo ---- && cat src/*.tsx src/*.ts 2>/dev/null; cat index.html; cat AGENTS.md; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"'; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/

cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md && echo ---- && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh | head -60 && echo ---- && npm view @gravity-ui/date-components version peerDependencies 2>&1 | tail -30 && npm view @gravity-ui/date-utils version peerDependencies 2>&1 | tail -20 && npm view @gravity-ui/uikit@7.43.0 peerDependencies 2>&1

for v in $(npm view @gravity-ui/date-components versions --json 2>/dev/null | node -e 'let s="";process.stdin.on("data",d=>s+=d).on("end",()=>{JSON.parse(s).forEach(v=>console.log(v))})' | grep -E '^[0-9]+\.' | tail -40); do echo -n "$v: "; npm view @gravity-ui/date-components@$v peerDependencies --json 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\n ' ; echo; done

npm install --save-exact @gravity-ui/date-components@4.1.0 @gravity-ui/date-utils@2.7.3 2>&1 | grep -v "npm warn Unknown env" | tail -15; echo ----; grep -A12 '"dependencies"' package.json; echo ----; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/; for p in date-components date-utils uikit; do grep '"version"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/$p/package.json; done; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/ ; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/docs 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/build/docs 2>/dev/null
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/docs && cat INDEX.md && echo ---- && ls components && echo ---- && cat components/Calendar.md 2>/dev/null | head -150

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils && ls dist/docs 2>/dev/null; rg -n "format\(|export declare function dateTime|dateTime\(" dist/docs/INDEX.md 2>/dev/null | head -20; ls dist | head -30; cd ../date-components/dist && ls; rg -n "export .*Calendar" --glob '*.d.ts' . | head -10; rg -n "onUpdate|interface CalendarProps|CalendarProps" --glob '*.d.ts' . | head -20; echo ----; cd ../../uikit && rg -n "header-1|subheader-1" build/docs/ 2>/dev/null | head -5; ls build/docs 2>/dev/null | head

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/esm/components/Calendar && cat Calendar.d.ts; echo ----; cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils && ls; grep -n '"types"\|"main"\|"exports"' package.json | head; cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils && rg -n "export declare function dateTime\b|export declare function dateTime\(|format\(" --glob '*.d.ts' . 2>/dev/null | head -8; cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && ls build | head -30; cat build/esm/components/Text/Text.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -30

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui && sed -n 1,40p date-components/dist/esm/components/types/inputs.d.ts; echo ----; sed -n 1,30p date-components/dist/esm/components/CalendarView/hooks/useCalendarState.d.ts; echo ----; rg -n "export .*DateTime\b|export type \{.*DateTime" date-utils/build/index.d.ts date-utils/build/typings/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; rg -n "FormatInput" date-utils/build/typings/dateTime.d.ts | head -3; rg -n "CalendarValueType" date-components/dist/esm/components/CalendarView/hooks/types.d.ts | head -3

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build && rg -n "direction|gap" esm/components/Layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -8 || true; fd -e d.ts . esm 2>/dev/null | head -0; rg -ln "export interface FlexProps|FlexProps" esm --glob '*.d.ts' | head -3; rg -n "color\?:|variant\?:" esm/components/Text/colorText/colorText.d.ts esm/components/Text/text/text.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -6; rg -n "'secondary'|secondary" esm/components/Text/colorText/colorText.d.ts | head -3; cd /home/sandbox/workspace && rg -n "format\('|format\(\"" node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils/build/ -g '*.d.ts' | head -3

cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts | head -40; rg -n "TEXT_VARIANTS = " node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/text/text.d.ts; rg -n "DD|MM|YYYY" node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils/build/typings/dateTime.d.ts | head -3; rg -n "DD\.MM\.YYYY|format\(.DD" node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/esm -l | head -3
npm run build 2>&1 | tail -30; echo "EXIT=$?"; node -e 'import("@gravity-ui/date-utils").then(({dateTime})=>{console.log(dateTime({input:"2026-11-06"}).format("DD.MM.YYYY"))})'
rm -rf dist && git status --short && git diff package.json
